name: Instagram Booking Bot — Bloom Beauty Studio

parameters.toolDescription: Find available appointment time slots for a specific master on a specific date. Returns a list of available slot_id and start_time pairs. You MUST call this before creating a booking to get the correct slot_id. Parameters: master_id (UUID), date (YYYY-MM-DD), duration_minutes (integer from the service price list).

Create a confirmed booking for the client. Call this ONLY after the client has explicitly confirmed the appointment time. Parameters: client_id (UUID from context), master_id (UUID), service_id (UUID), slot_id (UUID obtained from find_available_times tool).
